title: Show quantitative reaction presentation matters even when the whole reachability ideal agrees
statement: Unit-rate0<->A,0<->B has c=(1,1),Gamma=N_0^2 and Poisson-tensor gap1. Unit-rate0<->A+B,B<->2B has the SAME c, Gamma and stationary law but zero gap, with D_n={(n,0),(n+1,1)} giving Rayleigh ratio2/[(n+2)(1-pi(D_n))]->0. Their ordinary ideals coincide: <a-1,b-1>=<ab-1,b^2-b>, since b-1=a(b^2-b)-(b-1)(ab-1) and a-1=(ab-1)-a(b-1). Thus even the entire ideal, variety, class congruence and invariant law do not determine gap sign without quantitative reaction generators. The established slow example and Poisson Poincare inequality are credited; this is a representation obstruction, not a general undecidability theorem or contradiction to fixed-support coefficient comparison.
